metadata.source: Borough of Glen Rock Municipal Financial Statements (NJ DCA DLGS)

revenueSources.source: Local Property Tax for Municipal Purposes
State Energy Tax Receipts & Formula Aid

majorAppropriations.details: 24/7 patrol coverage, emergency 911 dispatch, school resource officers (SRO), and Glen Rock Volunteer Ambulance Corps support.
Curbside trash and recycling collection, snow plowing, road repaving, municipal fleet maintenance, and tree forestry.

majorAppropriations.category: Municipal Employee Health, Life & Pension Benefits
majorAppropriations.details: Health insurance coverage (privately pooled JIF after exiting SHBP), PFRS/PERS state pension obligations, and workers comp.
Principal and interest payments on voter-approved capital improvement bonds for roadway reconstruction and flood prevention.

majorAppropriations.category: Glen Rock Public Library (Dedicated 1/3 Mill Levy)
majorAppropriations.details: Operational funding for the Glen Rock Public Library on Broad Street, digital media archives, and youth programming.
Shared municipal court, Borough Attorney, labor counsel, engineering, and independent certified municipal audits.
Borough Administrator, Municipal Clerk, Tax Collector, Tax Assessor, and Information Technology operations.
Maintenance of Faber Field, Wilde Memorial Park, tennis courts, and the self-sustaining Glen Rock Municipal Pool utility.
State-mandated cash reserve to ensure 100% tax payments to the school district and Bergen County regardless of delinquency rates.
Apparatus acquisition, turnout gear, firehouse maintenance, and water hydrant service charges.
